status: Static caller-body and native-endpoint trace; no P06 source implementation. P04 complete exact-head acceptance remains pending.

ik_paths.current: Authored foot translation comes from Bevy GlobalTransform; height is re-admitted as SignedLength before ordinary_terrain_target; checked normal is erased through weighted alignment.
ik_paths.change: Admit scene plan once from the complete transform observation, pass SupportElevation directly to ordinary_terrain_target, retain Dir3 through both alignment wrappers. Keep the existing try_normalize inside the final slope/arc kernel: deleting it changes operation count/bits.

ik_paths.current: Terrain absolute support is stored as SignedLength in FootClearanceFloor::Terrain; completed floor callbacks carry Option<SignedLength> through three application functions before max/sphere/disk math.
ik_paths.change: Terrain variant retains SupportElevation with its separate SignedLength clearance. Floor callbacks accept ScenePlanPoint and retain FootClearanceFloor to the actual solver. Use a fallible finite native-height projection only where max/chord/disk arithmetic needs the scalar; remove implicit From<SignedLength> application adaptation. Preserve complete sole-first/toe-second max before final admission.
ik_paths.failure_order: Keep callback final-height finiteness checks before target.max: a negative overflowing sum must remain an error rather than being hidden by f32::max. Do not validate intermediate constituents earlier than the existing complete native equation.

ik_paths.current: Terminal support callbacks and sole/raised-support predicates pass native terrain heights between application functions.
ik_paths.change: Callbacks use ScenePlanPoint -> Option<SupportElevation>; sole_is_at_contact and raised_support_is_actual retain SupportElevation until their actual ankle-minus-support-minus-sole equation. Missing invalid query point or hit remains false/None, not zero. Preserve preparation mutation order, toe acceptance and every threshold.

ik_paths.current: Reference/retained plant support height is used directly to construct or update a complete native affine pose target. Missing support keeps the real authored/reference target.
ik_paths.change: Query with checked scene point and retain SupportElevation until the existing Vec3.with_y/max expression. The authored pose fallback is real observed geometry, not a fabricated terrain hit: preserve it and do not report support where absent.

ik_paths.current: Terrain maximum is reduced as raw f32 in a callback before capsule_terrain_penetration samples three spheres.
ik_paths.change: Keep highest SupportElevation through the callback and three-sample interface; project only in height + radius - sample.y. Keep no-hit penetration identity zero (zero displacement), kinematic exclusion, sample order and velocity retention.

scatter_paths.current: One native jitter centre forwards through coverage/height/community; owned hit elevations are erased at both TuftPlacement implementations.
scatter_paths.change: Admit the completed jitter ScenePlanPoint once and keep it through trait and community APIs. Return checked SupportElevation until InstanceData packing. Keep coverage and community scalar projections inside their actual mask/lattice/nearest-site kernels. GrassCommunityField native lattice/cache internals are an explicit numerical boundary; avoid retyping unrelated species weights.
scatter_paths.preservation: Exact lattice order, coverage-before-height-before-community, RNG/hash draws and native vista missing-neighbor centre-height calculation remain. Admit sampled vista elevation only after its complete slope calculation.

scatter_paths.change: Completed cell jitter produces one ScenePlanPoint passed through grass helpers and ShrubPlacement; retain SupportElevation and Dir3 until Transform/InstanceData construction. Do not split/recombine world_x/world_z between helpers.

scatter_paths.current: PlantSite -> PlantCaptureAnchor -> SceneCaptureState.plant_focus retain raw Vec3 after terrain support; camera and observation helpers take the root before native framing/distance math.
scatter_paths.change: Retain Position<Scene> from final root-with-embed calculation through these records and helpers. Scalar/vector projection belongs at actual Transform, camera framing, selection norm comparison and observation distance kernels. Preserve seed priority, x/z bit tie order, species filtering, plant bounds and existing tests. This extends the prior query-only inventory.

fixture_selection_addition.basis: Cargo.toml has no alternative example target/harness gates; examples/inspect-city-grounding.rs owns existing footprint, terrace, gate-approach and support-solution tests with committed Goslar data.
fixture_selection_addition.acceptance: Proposed existing selection only; require nonempty hosted output, preserve all existing cases/assertions, do not count compilation as execution.

limits: Not every original query candidate body is now claimed traced. Finish remaining callers and the recorded image/const admission decisions before source implementation.
The 28-degree foot orientation cap remains unchanged; it is not the distinct 40-degree walkable terrain grade.
No new tests, cases, assertions, fixture helpers, source edits or local project commands.
